bullets.text: In Murukkampattu village, a newly built Rs 16.75 lakh water tank remains unused for three years, and the office should address this drinking water problem.
Karnataka plans to launch an AI-based facial recognition attendance system with online parent updates, and our office should monitor these higher education reforms.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated in Lucknow that artificial intelligence cannot replace the livelihoods of skilled workers, and our office should note this perspective.

takeaways: A drinking water tank constructed for Rs 16.75 lakhs in Murukkampattu village remains unused for three years.
Local residents in Tiruttani continue to struggle for basic water supply despite government expenditure.

stories.title: Skipping classes? Think again. Karnataka to roll out AI-based attendance system with online updates for parents
takeaways: Karnataka Higher Education department proposes rolling out an artificial intelligence facial recognition attendance system for students.
Parents will receive online updates, showcasing a competitive regional model in digital governance and AI implementation.

stories.title: AI cannot take jobs of skilled workers: PM Modi
takeaways: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that artificial intelligence cannot replace skilled workers and livelihoods.
The statement highlights the importance of human skill alongside technological advancement in the AI sector.
